text: Effective time management matters a lot in today's fast-paced work environment. People who build good organizational habits tend to meet deadlines and feel less stressed. There are a few strategies that can help you get more done. First, prioritize. Figure out the most important tasks and do them first, so the critical stuff gets finished. Second, cut down on distractions, since setting aside blocks of time for focused work is widely seen as helpful. Finally, take regular breaks to keep your performance up.
